title: Run the managed preview with Node
responsibility: Starts the single managed preview with the runtime used by SvelteKit sync, then removes its temporary launcher on exit.

inputs.name: previewNode.args
inputs.description: Preview root, optional Vite config, host and port arguments forwarded unchanged.

outputs.name: previewNode
outputs.description: Exit code of the managed Node process; signals are forwarded and its temporary launcher is removed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Fails without starting a second preview when launcher compilation or process startup is unavailable.
examples: Could not prepare the managed preview runtime.
